newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit in tight range as dollar subdued in Asia.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit in tight range as dollar subdued in Asia.

text.p: A largely subdued dollar/majors in Asia kept the ringgit in a sleepy trading range, dealers said.
"Nothing much happened. It was a slow day," said a Malaysian bank dealer. The ringgit traded within its forecast range.
Dollar/ringgit shorts covered their positions late in the Malaysian day to bring down the ringgit a shade.
Trading was also cautious at the start of a new month after usual month-end gyrations on corporate demand.
Some dealers said expectations that Japanese multinationals may repatriate profits home this month may cap the ringgit.
Japanese corporates close their books at the end of their financial year in March and normally take their money out of Malaysia by buying dollars for ringgit.
At the Kuala Lumpur close at 1000 GMT, ringgit was at 2.4858/65 a dollar from 2.4820/30 at the Friday close.
The firmer interbank rates due to Tuesday's issue of one billion ringgit Bank Negara bills caused swaps to move to the right, dealers said.
"Players are trading on swap points," said one interbank dealer. One-month swaps traded at 34/37 from 25/28, he said.
